verdict.rationale: Stripe documents verifying government-issued ID documents from more than 120 countries, and a customer notes you can specify which document types are accepted. However, the pack never names the document types (passports, national IDs, driver licenses, residence permits) or points to a published supported list. Community reports of unsupported Polish IDs and rejected Chinese passports point to coverage gaps, though they do not contradict the 120+ country claim. Missing for 10: explicit documented document types (passports, national IDs, driver licenses, residence permits), a published per-country supported-document list, and independent corroboration of coverage breadth.

support.subject: As an ops lead, the platform verifies government IDs from a documented breadth of countries and document types — passports, national IDs, driver licenses, residence permits — with the supported list published

citations.quote: Verify the authenticity of government-issued ID documents from more than 120 countries
I like that it lets you specify the types of accepted docs.
